security.subtitle: We connect your data capture, CRMs, and spreadsheets into a unified ecosystem. We transform operational chaos into a linear flow that processes and fires documents in seconds, without human intervention.

faq.title: Frictionless Deployment.
faq.subtitle: We resolve your technical and commercial team's questions regarding implementation and data governance.

questions.q: Do we have to replace our current ERP or CRM?
questions.a: Absolutely not. We integrate via API (REST/SOAP) or Webhooks into your existing infrastructure (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics). Our system acts as an intelligent automation layer on top of your databases, without altering your core operations.

questions.q: If the system quotes automatically, what is the role of our sales team?
questions.a: Your sales reps will stop being 'data entry clerks'. The automation handles the administrative heavy lifting (inventory crossing, PDF generation, data profiling), allowing your executives to step in strictly to negotiate complex agreements, review credit, and close deals.

questions.q: How do you guarantee the system won't send incorrect or unauthorized pricing?
questions.a: Our architecture queries pricing, inventory, and discount rules in real-time directly from your ERP. Additionally, we implement 'Human Gates': if a quote exceeds a specific threshold or requires a custom discount, the system pauses and routes it to a manager for approval.

questions.q: How long does it take to get the automation workflow into production?
questions.a: We work through agile, phased deployments. The initial workflow (Lead-to-Cash: from the initial text message to the formal quote) is typically in production within 10 to 20 days, depending on the architecture and accessibility of your current systems.

questions.q: What about the privacy and security of our commercial data?
questions.a: Your confidential information is never used to train public AI models. We do not store your customer catalogs or billing data on external servers. Our engine operates exclusively through authenticated API connections; it functions as a high-speed bridge processing data in real-time between your own platforms (Communication Channels, CRM, ERP) and then disconnects, keeping absolute control of the information within your ecosystem.

questions.q: Is this a SaaS model where I have to pay per-user licenses for my team?
questions.a: No. Unlike traditional software that penalizes your growth by charging extra rent for every new sales rep (per-seat pricing), we operate as dedicated infrastructure. Your investment is based on the initial deployment of the ecosystem and a flat monthly retainer for operational maintenance, security, and data processing. You can scale your sales team from 5 to 50 reps, and your retainer remains exactly the same.
